Confirmed defect: all six GO templates had flags1 (GO_FLAG_IN_USE). GameObject::Create copies those flags to GAMEOBJECT_FIELD_FLAGS, and the native Use admission rejects IN_USE/NOT_SELECTABLE before its goober spell. No gameobject_action, template/GUID SmartAI or GO spawn-script row clears the blocker. Regression reconstructs initial flags1 through the actual initialization assignment and actual Use admission block; the required interaction assertion fails against the old World snapshot. A fixed snapshot passes, then live migrated data passes. This is not a client-observed failure.

Migration20 clears only bit1 on the six type10 templates. Temporary-table regression reconstructs flags1, executes the migration twice, checks all six become0, checks flags17 becomes16, preserves unrelated template241741, and preserves selected spell/visual/consumable/script fields. The live migration was applied while worldserver was stopped after a scoped private backup; update metadata is RELEASED with the exact SHA1 below.

Shared go_grey_shoals_supplies is retained on244704. Its actual OnGossipHello returns false in Stormheim, allowing normal use after the flag repair; in area8297 with incomplete44737 it still awards its scoped supply credit and deactivates the object before normal use. The regression executes this production hook for both boundaries. No Grey Shoals spawn or quest data was modified.

GO Data22 references PlayerCondition36239, absent from both runtime DB2 and Hotfix. This absence is retained as evidence, not repaired by inventing a condition. ConditionMgr::IsPlayerMeetingCondition accepts missing condition records; the audited GameObject::Use goober branch does not explicitly evaluate Data22. Client-side visibility and admission remain pending. No additional quest gate was invented for a shared template.

Regression executes native killer-owner resolution, KillRewarder reward admission and delayed50ms credit, KilledMonster direct/alias routes, objective getter/setter/save marks, HasQuestObjectiveComplete/CanCompleteQuest, CompleteQuest automatic TASK reward dispatch, group selection and event credit.60 full runs cover all15 spawned source templates x both factions x player/pet killers. All five weights, mixed weights,99/99.5/100/100.5/102 boundaries, repeated victim/reward/counter caps, hidden sparse counters and reconstructed saved199/200 pass.

Native bonus-area exit removes the quest log slot, so deferred or later kills cannot advance it outside the area; partial status counters remain. Re-entry restores counters through native UpdateQuestObjectiveData. AddQuest preservation and saved-state reconstruction are fixture adapters informed by the production method, not actual database login/restart verification. Native completed/rewarded gates prevent another activation. RewardQuest XP/money/persistence and full packet serialization are adapters; production inspection shows reward-status insertion and synchronous quest-status transaction, but those database operations were not executed by the harness.

Repaired admission is tested for all six objects and both factions, repeated use, hidden/not-selectable rejection, native effect134 null/non-player/wrong-mode target rejection and group range/world/body gates. Full GameObject::Use activation/cast scheduling and native GO self-target selection are adapters; credit tests do not prove lock casts, visual playback, collision approaches or complete consumable lifecycle.

Canonical worldserver was restarted after the data repair to refresh templates, reached ready, exited gracefully0 and left no DBErrors/stderr. It remains stopped as before this work. No production C++ changed; no new Release executable build is claimed. Existing canonical executable hash is unchanged.
